parameters.name: CacheTtlMax
parameters.description: The maximum TTL period of the cached data retrieved from the origin DNS server. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 30 to 86400.

parameters.name: CacheTtlMin
parameters.description: The minimum time-to-live (TTL) period of the cached data retrieved from the origin Domain Name System (DNS) server. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 30 to 86400.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The domain name. You can call the [DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d\_0) operation to obtain the domain name.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the cache-accelerated domain name. You can call the [ListCloudGtmInstances](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-listcloudgtminstances?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d\_0) operation to obtain the instance ID.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English Default: **zh**

parameters.name: SourceDnsServer
parameters.description: The origin DNS servers. A maximum of 10 origin DNS servers are supported.

parameters.name: SourceEdns
parameters.description: Specifies whether the origin DNS server supports Extension Mechanisms for DNS (EDNS). Valid values: NOT_SUPPORT and SUPPORT.

parameters.name: SourceProtocol
parameters.description: The origin protocol policy. Valid values: TCP and UDP. Default value: UDP.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns add-dns-cache-domain --lang en --domain-name example.com --instance-id dns-cn-00000 --cache-ttl-min 30 --cache-ttl-max 86400 --source-protocol UDP --source-edns SUPPORT --remark test --source-dns-server Port=53 Host=192.168.0.1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns AddDnsCacheDomain --region cn-hangzhou --SourceEdns SUPPORT --DomainName 'example.com' --InstanceId 'dns-cn-00000' --SourceDnsServer.1.Port 53 --SourceProtocol UDP --CacheTtlMin 30 --SourceDnsServer.1.Host '192.168.0.1' --Lang en --CacheTtlMax 86400 --Remark test
